top_signals.title: Crude oil prices and refinery margins generally increased throughout the third quarter

top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Chancellor says ‘It is my job to protect resilience of the UK economy and the budget will do that’ in the face of international headwinds
top_signals.summary: Chancellor of the Exchequer, John Healey used the IMF Annual Meetings in Bangkok to set out how the UK and its international partners can work together to respond to global economic headwinds and strengthen the conditions for growth.
